builds.name: Bulkier Nemesis
builds.desc: This build aims to utilize the Effect Refine of 'Dark Creator S' and Laguz Friend 4 to have a very hard to kill Nemesis with very potent damage reduction potential. Mystic Boost 3 seal is optional, albeit recommended due to the existence of units like Felix: Sword Savant who have built-in Hexblade effects, which the seal negates. If Boulder is currently inaccessible, Ignis is the second best option with Nemesis' 54 Def in this build (assuming S Rank Summoner support, and +10 merge). While he has trouble killing Brave Felix, he can at least survive a combat, which for a Grail unit is very impressive. Just be warned that the investment is very costly, both in Foddered skills, and Ascended Florets and Trait Fruits.
